gloss_distractors: a habit of avoiding hard decisions
senses.caution: Only say it about other people. As feedback it is vague, so add a specific behaviour, such as leading with your recommendation.
senses.definition: Coming across as calm, clear and senior enough to be handed a decision.

gloss_distractors: a willingness to take big risks
senses.caution: As a verb it can suggest you hid a problem instead of solving it. Do not use it about numbers or facts, especially with auditors or in writing.
senses.definition: Skill in handling something delicate so smoothly that the difficulty never shows.
